message: transient noise leaves out {sources} noise source(s) in {devices} device(s): tabulated sources, and flicker sources when no flicker band is set, are not generated in the time domain, so these contribute nothing to this run
description: With --tran-noise, each white noise source a device declares becomes a random current in the transient run, and (from 2.57.0) each flicker source (flicker_noise, SPICE's KF, 1/f^e) a sum of sinusoids from --tran-noise-fmin (default 1/(run length)) to fmax/4. A tabulated source (noise_table) has an arbitrary spectrum that is not synthesized yet; it is skipped. So are flicker sources when --tran-noise-fmin is at or above fmax/4 (an empty band). The noise in this run is then lower than the circuit's. A .noise analysis of the same circuit includes every source.
actions: If the left-out sources do not matter in your band, ignore this.
Run a .noise analysis to see how large they are next to the generated sources.
For flicker sources, lower --tran-noise-fmin below fmax/4, or raise --tran-noise.
